theme: Deoxyribonucleotide pool metabolism: breakdown, salvage and synthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the catabolic, degradative arm of deoxynucleotide metabolism (ADA/PNP-dependent purine and pyrimidine deoxynucleoside breakdown), framed against the salvage and de novo synthesis that maintain balanced dNTP pools.

theme: NGF/TRKA neurotrophin signalling and p75NTR survival-death control
core_role: The shared pathways are the TRKA receptor tyrosine kinase arm of NGF signalling (RAS/MAPK, ERK5, p38, PI3K/AKT, PLC-gamma, CREB) driving neuronal survival, differentiation and transcription, set against the p75NTR/proNGF death-and-survival signalling of the additional set.

theme: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair pathway choice
core_role: The shared pathways are the core DSB response machinery (ATM-mediated sensing, NHEJ and its balance with homologous recombination), framed here as the process that fails when BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 are defective.

theme: Hormonal control of hepatic glucose and lipid metabolism (glucagon/AMPK)
core_role: The shared pathways are the metabolic switching outputs (PKA- and AMPK-driven control of gluconeogenesis, triglyceride synthesis and fatty acid homeostasis) that execute fasting/glucagon signalling.

theme: ER membrane contact sites and non-vesicular lipid transfer
core_role: The shared pathways are about ER membrane shaping and ER-membrane tethering that enable non-vesicular phospholipid (PI/PC) transfer between organelles, the platform on which glycolipid and ceramide transfer also operates.

theme: DNA double-strand break repair and its regulation at break sites
core_role: The shared pathways are the core DSB sensing and NHEJ/HR repair machinery, framed as the repair reaction that chromatin remodelling, PARylation and protein recruitment to break sites regulate.

theme: Type 2 immunity: Th2, IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 and eosinophils
core_role: The shared pathways are the effector side of type 2 immunity (Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13 production, eosinophil and mast cell activation against helminths), framed against the cytokine signalling, granulocyte differentiation and negative regulation that tune it.

theme: Plasma lipoprotein metabolism: assembly, clearance and remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways are about lipoprotein particle assembly and receptor-mediated clearance (VLDL, chylomicron, LDL) and cholesterol uptake/storage, the delivery-and-uptake arm of a system that also includes particle remodelling and signalling.

theme: Endosomal recycling and Golgi membrane trafficking regulated by small GTPases
core_role: The shared pathways are the membrane trafficking steps themselves (endocytosis, endosome tubulation, recycling to the plasma membrane, Golgi budding and secretion), framed as the outputs controlled by Rab and ARF GTPase signalling.

theme: Nucleotide-sugar synthesis and protein glycosylation and its disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are the supply side of glycosylation: hexosamine/UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid synthesis and Golgi nucleotide-sugar transport (with their CDG-type defects), feeding the N-glycan and GPI-anchor processing of the additional set.

theme: Coronavirus replication and host translation control
core_role: The shared pathways are about SARS-CoV replicase translation, RNA capping, frameshifting and genome replication alongside viral modulation of host translation, framed as a virus-host contest over the translation and replication machinery.

theme: Presynaptic modulation of neurotransmitter release
core_role: The shared pathways are presynaptic control mechanisms (calcium channel gating, G-protein/GIRK inhibition, kainate and GABA modulation) that tune synaptic vesicle exocytosis, here applied to regulating glutamate and GABA release.

theme: Renin-angiotensin system and blood pressure/volume regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the renin-angiotensin-kinin peptide system (angiotensin generation and signalling, bradykinin breakdown) acting on renal sodium and water excretion, framed as body-fluid and blood pressure homeostasis.

theme: Glycolysis and cellular energy buffering
core_role: The shared pathways are glucose catabolism via glycolysis coupled to ATP/ADP exchange and the creatine-phosphocreatine shuttle, framed as cellular energy supply that is regulated by fructose 2,6-bisphosphate and ends in lactate fermentation.

theme: Embryonic axial patterning: neural plate, hindbrain and limbs
core_role: The shared pathways are early body-plan patterning (neural plate and border specification, HOX-driven hindbrain segmentation, dorsoventral and anteroposterior axis and boundary formation), the positional-information programme also used in limb morphogenesis.

theme: Angiogenesis and its positive and negative regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are pro-angiogenic VEGF-driven endothelial proliferation, migration and sprouting, framed against the negative regulators and wound-healing context of the additional set.

theme: Glial myelination and axon regeneration after nervous system injury
core_role: The shared pathways are glial (oligodendrocyte and Schwann cell) myelination, gliosis and injured-axon regrowth, framed as the nervous system's injury-and-repair response including growth-promoting and growth-inhibiting axonal signals.

theme: Notch signalling to the nucleus and transcriptional targets
core_role: The shared pathways are Notch receptor intracellular-domain signalling and target gene transcription (including oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants), framed as the downstream output of receptor proteolysis and its use in developmental and T-cell fate decisions.

theme: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and organic acidaemias
core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial catabolism of leucine, isoleucine, valine and related acyl-CoAs (with biotin-dependent carboxylases) and their inborn errors, the downstream steps after the BCKDH reaction defective in MSUD.

theme: Macrophage lipoprotein uptake and foam cell formation
core_role: The shared pathways are lipoprotein-driven cholesterol loading and storage in macrophages leading to foam cells, framed as an atherogenic uptake process.

theme: Vitamin D and phosphate homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways are vitamin D activation/inactivation (CYP27B1, CYP24A1), PTH response and renal sodium-phosphate transport, framed as the endocrine control of phosphate balance that the SLC34 transporter defects also disrupt.

theme: Ciliary protein trafficking and ciliogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are targeting of membrane and lipidated cargo into the cilium (ARL13B, BBSome, VxPx) and cilium assembly, framed as part of building a functional cilium from basal body docking and transition zone.

theme: Postsynaptic actin cytoskeleton and dendritic spine structure
core_role: The shared pathways are about actin-based structural organisation of the postsynapse and spine plasticity, framed as cytoskeletal remodelling (filopodia, Rho GTPases) that shapes dendrites and receptor delivery.

theme: Microglial neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's-type neurodegeneration
core_role: The shared pathways are microglial/glial activation and amyloid-beta/tau handling, framed as the neuroinflammatory response driving synaptic dysfunction and neuronal death.

theme: B cell activation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are B cell identity and germinal centre/Tfh-driven differentiation into antibody-secreting plasma cells, framed within the humoral adaptive response that also generates memory B cells via co-stimulation.

theme: Protein N-glycosylation and nucleotide-sugar supply disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are the glycosylation machinery proper (nucleotide-sugar transport into the Golgi/ER, N-glycan processing, oligosaccharide catabolism) and its congenital disorders, fed by the hexosamine and sialic acid synthesis of the additional set.

theme: Nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport for glycosylation
core_role: The shared pathways are synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid and other activated sugars and their SLC35 transport into the Golgi, with the congenital disorders caused by their defects, framed as the substrate supply for glycan assembly.

theme: Cellular response to heavy metals
core_role: The shared pathways are metallothionein- and MTF1-mediated detoxification responses to zinc, copper, mercury and iron, framed as a general metal-stress defence.

theme: Microtubule-based organelle transport in neurons
core_role: The shared pathways are motor-driven axonal transport of mitochondria, vesicles and endolysosomes, framed as maintenance of long neuron projections and motor neuron survival.

theme: Kidney development: nephron and ureteric bud morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the morphogenetic and differentiation steps of metanephric kidney formation (nephric duct, ureteric bud, mesenchyme-to-epithelium transition, nephron segments), framed against the proliferation and survival controls of the additional set.

theme: Leukocyte chemotaxis, homing and lymphoid tissue organisation
core_role: The shared pathways are chemokine (CCR7/S1P)-driven lymphocyte and dendritic cell migration into lymphoid organs and lymph node development, framed within the broader leukocyte chemotaxis of the additional set.

theme: Insulin signalling and hepatic glycogen/glucose control
core_role: The shared pathways are the insulin receptor-IRS-AKT2 signalling cascade and its attenuation, framed as the control of glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis that also involves glucokinase and glycogenolysis.

theme: Mitosis: spindle, centrosome, chromosome segregation and cytokinesis
core_role: The shared pathways are mitotic spindle assembly, centrosome function, kinetochore attachment and cytokinesis (PLK1/AURKA control), framed alongside the chromosome condensation and sister chromatid cohesion steps of cell division.

theme: Lysosomal glycan and glycosphingolipid catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are lysosomal degradation of oligosaccharides and gangliosides and the storage diseases from its defects, framed as the catabolic end of glycoconjugate turnover that begins with N-glycan processing.

theme: tRNA and rRNA modification and translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways are RNA base modification and tRNA aminoacylation that ensure accurate translation, framed within the broader processing and maturation of tRNA and rRNA.

theme: Oncogenic NOTCH1 signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are activated and constitutively active (mutant) NOTCH1/2 signalling to the nucleus, framed as cancer-driving gain of Notch function.

theme: FGFR signalling and oncogenic FGFR mutants
core_role: The shared pathways are FGFR3/4 ligand binding and FRS/SHC adaptor cascades, framed as the shared downstream signalling across FGFR family members and their activating mutants.

theme: DNA replication initiation and E2F-driven cell cycle
core_role: The shared pathways are E2F-regulated G1/S transition and replication origin initiation and unwinding, framed as the proliferative S-phase entry of the cell cycle.

theme: Neurotrophin Trk receptor signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are NGF-TRKA receptor signalling through RAS, PLC-gamma, STAT3 and p38, framed as the shared Trk kinase signalling module also used by NTF3-NTRK3.

theme: Thymic T cell development and selection
core_role: The shared pathways are thymocyte proliferation, survival and positive selection driving T cell differentiation, framed within thymic development that also includes migration and negative selection for self-tolerance.

theme: Regulatory T cell-mediated immune suppression
core_role: The shared pathways are Treg differentiation and the suppression of effector T cell activation, proliferation and cytokines, framed as the inhibitory side of balancing T helper responses.

theme: Actin filament dynamics in cell motility
core_role: The shared pathways are actin network assembly, crosslinking, capping and severing, framed as the cytoskeletal machinery driving lamellipodial cell migration.

theme: Synapse formation by trans-synaptic adhesion molecules
core_role: The shared pathways are neurexin-neuroligin and other synaptic adhesion molecules organising presynaptic assembly and excitatory transmission, framed as trans-synaptic organisers that also cluster postsynaptic receptors.

theme: Lung development and branching morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are lung branching, growth and vascular development driven by epithelial-mesenchymal proliferation, framed within thoracic organogenesis including diaphragm and lung mesenchyme.

theme: FGFR1/FGFR2 signalling and isoform-specific activation
core_role: The shared pathways are FGFR1/2 ligand binding (IIIb/IIIc isoforms) and FRS/SHC/PLC/PI3K cascades including activating mutants, framed by FGFR2 alternative splicing that sets ligand specificity.

theme: tRNA modification and aminoacylation for translation
core_role: The shared pathways are tRNA maturation (splicing, wobble modifications, wybutosine) and aminoacylation for cytosolic and mitochondrial translation, framed as preparing tRNAs for accurate protein synthesis.

theme: Cardiac muscle development and heart morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are ventricular/atrial myocardium growth, trabeculation, compaction and septation, framed as heart chamber morphogenesis.

theme: EGFR/ERBB2 receptor signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are EGFR and ERBB2 adaptor cascades (GRB2, SHC1, GAB1, PI3K, PLC-gamma), framed as receptor tyrosine kinase signalling feeding phosphoinositide pathways.

theme: Platelet activation
core_role: The shared pathways are platelet agonist receptor signalling (thrombin/PAR, ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thromboxane, prostacyclin), framed as hemostatic activation that drives integrin and cytoskeletal remodelling.

theme: Inorganic anion transport and its disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide, oxalate and chloride exchangers (SLC4, SLC26) and acid-base handling with their channelopathy-like diseases, framed within broader epithelial anion transport including sodium-phosphate cotransport.
